The '''Scout Wheelbike''' was a military reconnaissance vehicle, a modification of a civilian [[Gallis-Tech]] design.

==Characteristics==
A [[wheelbike]] was essentially a single large wheel about two meters in diameter, with in the pilot and propulsion systems inside it.<ref name="SWAJ6" />

While the underlying civilian version had two seats, the militarized Scout Wheelbike was a single-pilot vehicle, replacing the passenger pillion with a a repeating blaster.<ref name="SWAJ6" />

==History==
The Gallis-Tech Scout Wheelbike was one of several types of wheelbike used by the [[COMPNOR Regiment]] deployed on [[Sedesia]], due to the planet's weather being hostile to repulsorcraft.<ref name="SWAJ6" />

The pilots had originally been trained to ride [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], and had heavier armor and enclosed helmets suitable for the role, but lacked specific wheelbike training.<ref name="SWAJ6" />
